observations.global: Rails, two separated front housings, U opening and paired pierced mounts readable. No central dummy transverse cylinder. Dimensions/poses and small attachment identity remain estimated.
observations.normal_and_shadows: Native planar regions readable without a new demonstrated diagonal reflection defect. Upper dark patches vanish with shadow rays disabled in a separate constant-fixture test; retain real shadows in final material views.
observations.weld_macro: Corrected camera from inside U now exposes the continuous authored weld. The roughly periodic small bead ripple is an original estimate, not a measured or traced factory weld.
observations.return_macro: Corrected inner camera shows actual rounded return and its vertical wall, with continuous curved highlights in this diagnostic. The 1.8mm wall is author geometry, not a physical measurement.
observations.camera_limit: First outside macros were occluded and are kept as diagnostics, not used as proofs of the interior joint.
